message: Renovate proposes patch updates after 1 day (minimumReleaseAge: "1 day" in packageRules[0] of renovate.json), but npm waits 3 days (min-release-age: 3 in .npmrc); its pull requests bring in versions younger than npm accepts, or fail where the lockfile is re-checked
fix: Make minimumReleaseAge in packageRules[0] of renovate.json at least 3 days, or limit the rule to the packages that need a shorter delay
